vb_textbox.text: The gnomes come in pairs, there are 2 pairs of them. One will be either red or purple and the other will be brown or green. I found in the first half of the task, the red or purple ones resulted in more mushrooms, then it switched to the other two. If you click on a purple one and it yields more mushrooms, you will find the red is very likely too as well. The inverse is true too. Think of the pairs actually, as red and purple for one and brown and green for the other. Generally one of them will give more mushrooms at any given time. If you see the amount drop to below 3, try a gnome from the other pair and see if it produces more. To summarise, you will always be targeting both the red and purple at any one time or the brown and green. I hope this makes sense and helps you out! Once you get started, it should become clear. Good luck!
